data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2020 were 140.676 (000s). Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows adverse prior-year development (years 2017 and 2018) totalling approximately 11.224 (millions), equivalent to ~8.0% of opening reserves. The deterioration was driven by large natural catastrophe losses and specific large losses (e.g. Hurricane Michael, Typhoon Hagibis and the NiSource gas explosion) together with underperformance in certain quota share arrangements and related reinsurance recoveries, resulting in a net strengthening of reserves.
raw_causal_phrases: In addition the 2018 Account suffered a prior year adverse movement of 2.2% points from the 2017 Account AXA/XL Whole Account Quota Share contract.
The 2018 Year of Account proved to be extremely challenging for the worldwide Insurance and Reinsurance Industry.

The Whole Account Quota Share Treaty cession with AxaXL was again heavily influenced by the 2018 Catastrophe losses as well as many large risk events and consequently is still underperforming the additional diversified portfolio of 44 quota share treaties.
The Syndicate's exposure to Hurricane Michael is, however, within expectation and is capped in terms of the loss size with an Event limit.
The Syndicate has unfortunately suffered a material loss from Typhoon Hagibis
the Syndicate was exposed to the NiSource Massachusetts Gas Explosion where the there was a total limits loss of $800 Million, of which Syndicate 2689's share is $5.3 Million.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from the Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding) prior-year comparative column. Prior-year development (11.224) was calculated from the gross claims development table (columns 2017 and 2018) because no standalone 'movement in prior year's provision' gross figure was provided. The triangle in the report is labelled as GBP '000 but totals and other tables are denominated in $'000; figures treated as report currency (USD) thousands and converted to millions for this output. exact_reserve_text quoted is a narrative reference to a prior-year adverse movement (percent points) for 2018; no explicit gross GBP /$ amount of prior year development was stated, so triangle-based calculation used. Confidence flags: opening reserves 1.0 (explicit), prior-year movement 0.8 (calculated from triangle).
